originator: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.15
source_units: percent per annum, investment basis, daily, not seasonally adjusted
units: annual decimal yield; investment-basis quote, not a full continuously compounded zero curve
cleaning: Convert percent to decimal by division by 100
Drop missing holiday observations and record their dates
Reject duplicate/nonfinite observations; no interpolation or forward-fill in stored rates
limitations: One 3-month Treasury yield is a documented discounting proxy, not an OIS/zero curve for all maturities
Using an earlier available observation requires an explicit backward as-of rule in the pricing study
Historical downloaded series may have revisions; citation requested for public-domain Federal Reserve observations
